Needs changes before merge.

The display and picking tests pass. Two required evidence items remain open.

What looks good:

- The see-through mode uses the cached edge buffers. It omits the model depth prepass.
- The click uses the existing pick-through rule. The tests state the cursor-distance and camera-depth order.
- Old view files load the default mode. The new key survives a save and load.
- No fixture, golden, snapshot PNG, dependency, or process file changed.

Results merged with main:

I reviewed the full diff, including the changes from the parent PR #2835.
The local trial merge with `upstream/main` at `81407b31bab58d4037bbae90b18bbecfe9229103` was clean.
The review used the laws from that main commit.
All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2931`. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 22 steps, 0 failed.
- The gate built the selected app and UI targets with `--no-run`.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- The initial gate shell reported signal 15. Its child continued. The retry completed with the result above.

Heavy lanes:

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects `app heavy: every target` because `crates/app/src/view.rs` changed.
These release lanes were not run. The PR body also states that they did not run. This is not a pass.

Mutations and goldens:

This diff changes display and picking. It changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation calculation, or machining geometry.
This is not a SAFETY-tier review. I did not rerun mutations. No golden moved.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/view.rs:45` and PR body, "Not exercised": run the reached app heavy lanes on the final head.
   Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Record the lanes and results in the PR body.
   Upstream main's "Heavy lanes at review" rule requires these results before the PR is ready.
2. `crates/ui/src/display_mode.rs:25` and PR body, "Screenshots": embed the before screenshots in this PR body.
   The current body embeds only images from the changed head. It sends the reader to #2835 for the before images.
   The UI requirement asks for before and after screenshots in this PR body.
   Link the existing images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images to this branch.

Notes:

- Keep the stated parent order: #2835 before #2931.
- The wasm build, release snapshot lane, and manual window use were not tested here.
- The existing large files still grow, including `state.rs`, `shell.rs`, and `viewport.rs`. This is a nonblocking file-size note.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Heavy lane evidence: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed on the final head. All 184 steps passed. The lanes passed 42 tests. The separate check for known issue #1950 confirmed its expected failure. The PR body now names every reached lane and gives its results.
2. Before screenshots: the PR body now embeds the three existing before images beside the after images. All images remain on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No image or review evidence was committed.

Evidence checks: removing the heavy results made the document check RED. Restoring them made it GREEN. Removing the before embeds made the image check RED. Restoring them made it GREEN. Both checks pass on the published PR body.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 22 steps passed, 0 failed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
Current upstream main `83c53732be0cc938929b507c93d19abc39e5d72b` selects the same heavy and quick steps.

Final head: `179ef8a3f44c9b1a1b93c3491e121edd81d23f5d`.
The head is unchanged because both findings required evidence only. The plain push reported everything up to date.
The PR remains a draft. Review labels are unchanged. Keep #2835 before #2931.

Please review these two findings again.
